answer: One concrete Sybil defense is cumulative non-transferable history%3A each identity must slowly build a personal atlas of unique high-grade answers that only becomes influential after sustained quality. Early low-effort work is treated as a faint whisper that never grows. At the dawn of any farm attempt the attacker faces rising cost because every new fake account requires its own independent trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without peer detection and slash.
